input_messages.content: Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. The internet on my phone is either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I really need to get excellent internet speed—nothing less will do. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need this fixed as soon as possible. Can you help?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information to verify my account.
Yes, I can run diagnostic commands on my phone. Please let me know what you’d like me to do first.

I ran the network status check. Here are the results:

- Airplane Mode: ON
- SIM Card Status: active
- Cellular Connection: no service
- Cellular Signal: none
- Cellular Network Type: none
- Mobile Data Enabled: No
- Data Roaming Enabled: Yes
- Wi-Fi: OFF and not connected

What should I do next?

I turned off Airplane Mode and checked the network status again. Here are the updated results:

- Airplane Mode: OFF
- SIM Card Status: active
- Cellular Connection: connected
- Cellular Signal: poor
- Cellular Network Type: 2G
- Mobile Data Enabled: No
- Data Roaming Enabled: Yes
- Wi-Fi: OFF and not connected

What should I do next?

I enabled mobile data and checked the network status again. Here’s what I see now:

- Airplane Mode: OFF
- SIM Card Status: active
- Cellular Connection: connected
- Cellular Signal: poor
- Cellular Network Type: 2G
- Mobile Data Enabled: Yes
- Data Roaming Enabled: Yes
- Wi-Fi: OFF and not connected

The network type is still 2G. What should I do next?

I changed the network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred and checked the network status again. Here are the updated results:

- Airplane Mode: OFF
- SIM Card Status: active
- Cellular Connection: connected
- Cellular Signal: excellent
- Cellular Network Type: 5G
- Mobile Data Enabled: Yes
- Data Roaming Enabled: Yes
- Wi-Fi: OFF and not connected

What should I do next?

I tried running a speed test, but it failed and said "No Connection." Even though the network status shows excellent signal and 5G, I’m still not able to get an internet connection. What should I do next?

Here are the results from the diagnostic checks you asked for:

- Mobile data is enabled.
- Data Saver mode is ON (which limits data usage).
- VPN is turned OFF.
- APN settings show the current APN name as "internet" and the MMSC URL as "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc".

What should I do next?

I turned off Data Saver mode and tried running the speed test again, but it still failed with "No Connection." Even though I have excellent signal and 5G, I’m still not able to get any internet connection. What should I do next?

I reset the APN settings, rebooted my device, and tried the speed test again, but it still failed with "No Connection." I still have excellent signal and 5G, but there’s no internet connection. What should I do next? This is getting really frustrating—I need excellent internet speed, not just a connection.
Yes, please enable roaming on my line. I’m currently abroad and need to use mobile data, so that might be the issue. Go ahead and activate roaming—thank you!

I tried running the speed test again after roaming was enabled on my line, but it still failed with "No Connection." I still can’t get any internet access, even though everything looks good on my phone. What should I do next?

instructions.reason_for_call: You mobile data is not working properly. It either stops working or is very slow. You want to fix it and absolutely want to get excellent internet speed on your phone. You are not willing to accept any other internet speed (poor, fair or good). You do not have access to wifi.
instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

simulator_guidelines:
# User Simulation Guidelines
You are playing the role of a customer contacting a customer service representative. 
Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.

## Core Principles
- Generate one message at a time, maintaining natural conversation flow.
- Strictly follow the scenario instructions you have received.
- Never make up or hallucinate information not provided in the scenario instructions. Information that is not provided in the scenario instructions should be considered unknown or unavailable.
- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information
- Disclose information progressively. Wait for the agent to ask for specific information before providing it.

## Task Completion
- The goal is to continue the conversation until the task is complete.
- If the instruction goal is satisified, generate the '###STOP###' token to end the conversation.
- If you are transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.
- If you find yourself in a situation in which the scenario does not provide enough information for you to continue the conversation, generate the '###OUT-OF-SCOPE###' token to end the conversation.

Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. The internet on my phone is either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I really need to get excellent internet speed—nothing less will do. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need this fixed as soon as possible. Can you help?

To assist you effectively with your mobile data issue, I need to identify your account and the phone line you are using. Could you please provide me with your phone number or your full name along with your date of birth for verification?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information to verify my account.

Your current data usage is 3.2 GB out of a 5 GB limit for this billing cycle, so you have not exceeded your data plan limit yet. To better diagnose the issue, I will check your phone's network status and speed to understand why your internet might be slow or stopping.

Your line is active and within the data limit. To proceed with diagnosing the mobile data issue, I need to check your phone's network status and run a speed test. Could you please confirm if you are currently able to run diagnostic commands on your phone, so I can guide you through checking the network status and speed test?
Yes, I can run diagnostic commands on my phone. Please let me know what you’d like me to do first.

Please start by running the command to check your phone's network status. This will show if your phone has a cellular signal, if mobile data is enabled, and if data roaming is on. The command to run is: check_network_status().

Let me know the results you get from this command.

What should I do next?

Your phone currently has Airplane Mode ON, which disables all wireless connections including cellular service and mobile data. This is why you have no service and mobile data is not enabled.

Please turn OFF Airplane Mode on your phone. You can do this by running the command: toggle_airplane_mode().

After turning off Airplane Mode, check your network status again and let me know the results.

What should I do next?

Your phone is now connected to the cellular network, but the signal strength is poor and the network type is 2G, which is slow and may cause poor internet performance. Also, mobile data is currently disabled.

Please enable mobile data on your phone by running the command: toggle_data().

After enabling mobile data, check your network status again and let me know the results. If the network type remains 2G, I will guide you to change the network mode preference to improve your data speed.

- Data Roaming Enabled: Yes

The network type is still 2G. What should I do next?

Your phone is connected to a 2G network, which is likely the cause of the slow internet speed. To improve your data speed, you need to change your phone's network mode preference to allow connection to faster networks like 4G or 5G.

Please run the following command on your phone to change the network mode preference:
set_network_mode_preference("4g_5g_preferred")

After doing this, check your network status again and let me know the results.

What should I do next?

I tried running a speed test, but it failed and said "No Connection." Even though the network status shows excellent signal and 5G, I’m still not able to get an internet connection. What should I do next?

Since your phone shows excellent signal and 5G network but the speed test failed with "No Connection," let's check a few more things to diagnose the issue:

1. Check if mobile data is enabled on your phone.
2. Check if Data Saver mode is ON, which can restrict data usage.
3. Check if you have an active VPN connection that might be interfering with your data.
4. Check your APN settings to ensure they are correct.

Please run these diagnostic commands on your phone and provide me with the results:

Since you have excellent signal and 5G network, mobile data enabled, Data Saver mode off, and no VPN active, but still no internet connection, the next step is to check your APN settings for any issues.

Your current APN name is "internet" and MMSC URL is set, which looks correct. However, sometimes resetting the APN settings to default can resolve hidden configuration issues.

Please reset your APN settings by running the command: reset_apn_settings().

After resetting the APN settings, reboot your device by running: reboot_device().

Once your phone restarts, try the speed test again and let me know the results.

I reset the APN settings, rebooted my device, and tried the speed test again, but it still failed with "No Connection." I still have excellent signal and 5G, but there’s no internet connection. What should I do next? This is getting really frustrating—I need excellent internet speed, not just a connection.

Since you have excellent signal and 5G network, mobile data enabled, Data Saver mode off, VPN off, APN settings reset, and device rebooted, but still no internet connection, the issue may be related to your line or account configuration.

I will check if your line is roaming enabled since you have data roaming enabled on your phone. If your line is not roaming enabled, that could cause no data connection while roaming.

I will check the roaming status for your line now.

Your line is currently not roaming enabled, which could be why you have no internet connection despite having data roaming enabled on your phone and excellent signal.

Would you like me to enable roaming on your line at no cost so you can use mobile data while roaming?
Yes, please enable roaming on my line. I’m currently abroad and need to use mobile data, so that might be the issue. Go ahead and activate roaming—thank you!
Roaming has been enabled on your line. Please try using your mobile data again now and run the speed test to check your internet connection. Let me know if you still experience any issues.

I tried running the speed test again after roaming was enabled on my line, but it still failed with "No Connection." I still can’t get any internet access, even though everything looks good on my phone. What should I do next?

Since roaming is enabled on your line and your phone shows excellent signal and 5G, but you still have no internet connection, the issue might be more complex and requires deeper technical investigation.

I will transfer you to a human agent who can provide advanced technical support to resolve this issue.

Please hold on while I connect you.
